creator: Solar System Scope / INOVE
credit: Textures by Solar System Scope / INOVE, CC BY 4.0. Resampled from 8192 × 4096 to 4096 × 2048; Earth cloud map stored as grayscale. No terrain generation, gap filling, sharpening, rotation, flipping, or longitude shift applied.
projection: Equirectangular (2:1), as identified by the source page
usageLimitations: Processed visualization textures derived from NASA elevation and imagery, not calibrated scientific products or observations of the historical playback instant.

The publisher warns that the pack can include fictional terrain to fill observational gaps and adjusted/saturated colors; it gives no per-pixel coverage mask or map-specific provenance breakdown for these files.
Earth is an adjusted composite of geodata, space imagery and NASA Blue Marble imagery. Its vegetation and snow coverage represent the producer's seasonal choices.
The cloud map is undated; brightness used as opacity is a rendering convention, not a calibrated atmospheric-opacity measurement.
Lunar texture contains source shading and heterogeneous-looking detail; do not interpret it as measured elevation or use it to claim per-crater geometric accuracy.

assets.name: Earth Day Map
processing: Decoded the source JPEG without applying a color transform; source embedded profile is sRGB IEC61966-2.1.
Downsampled 8192 × 4096 to 4096 × 2048 with Pillow LANCZOS. No explicit sharpening or generated detail.
Preserved RGB channels and original embedded sRGB profile; used JPEG 4:4:4 chroma to retain coastal and crater-edge color detail.
Encoded JPEG at quality 88, optimized Huffman tables, non-progressive.

orientationCheck.method: Compared aligned grayscale 512 × 256 reductions; full circular cross-correlation and flip alternatives used to detect orientation mismatch.
orientationCheck.changesApplied: None. Original pixel orientation and longitude wrap retained.

assets.inspectionNotes: Full map and native 4K crop inspected: same continent orientation and pole layout as 2K; finer coastline, island, mountain and inland texture detail is visible in the derivative.

assets.name: Earth Clouds
processing: Decoded the source JPEG without applying a color transform; source embedded profile is sRGB IEC61966-2.1.
Downsampled 8192 × 4096 to 4096 × 2048 with Pillow LANCZOS. No explicit sharpening or generated detail.

Source R=G=B at every pixel. Kept the identical green channel as an 8-bit grayscale L image. This JPEG has no embedded alpha; use sampled brightness as the white-cloud shell alphaMap. Treat the opacity data as non-color data.
Encoded JPEG at quality 88, optimized Huffman tables, non-progressive.

orientationCheck.method: Compared aligned grayscale 512 × 256 reductions; full circular cross-correlation and flip alternatives used to detect orientation mismatch.
orientationCheck.changesApplied: None. Original pixel orientation and longitude wrap retained.

assets.textureInterpretation: Single-channel grayscale opacity mask; black transparent, white opaque; noColorSpace / non-color data.
assets.inspectionNotes: Full map and native 4K crop inspected: cloud swirls and fine filament structure match the 2K positions, with visibly finer spatial detail; grayscale source brightness remains the alpha-mask convention.
